description: On-chain reputation registry for AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). register_agent, update_score, vouch_for and check_reputation were verified, and self-vouching, out-of-range scores, double vouches and score updates by a non-authority were rejected.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of trustnoagent/vouch-program. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/vouch-program. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (register_agent, update_score, vouch_for, check_reputation)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/vouch/
QA: devnet proof of the vouch flow and its guards
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Design a stake or reputation weight for vouches
